goal: Prevent initial block download stalls when an inbound or manual peer replies with empty headers
Allow another connected peer to immediately take over headers synchronization instead of stalling indefinitely
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (jeanpablojp, hodlinator)
Nonblocking objection: scope is unnecessarily narrow to inbound peers and empty headers (mzumsande)
Author waiting to reply to scope critique (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an indefinite headers sync stall during initial block download
Prevents nodes from getting stuck on manual or inbound peers when other synced peers are available
